tagline.zh: 温柔诊疗 · 透明定价

welcome.en: Hi! I am the Sunny Dental assistant — ask me about visits, prices, treatments or aftercare. How can I help?
welcome.zh: 你好！我是 Sunny 齿科助手——预约、价格、治疗、术后护理都可以问我。需要什么帮助？

q.en: What are your opening hours?

a.en: We are open Monday to Saturday, 9:00–19:00, and closed on Sundays and public holidays. Emergency line answers 24/7.
a.zh: 周一至周六 9:00–19:00，周日及法定节假日休息。急诊电话 24 小时接听。

q.en: How do I book an appointment?

a.en: Three ways: tap Book now, call our front desk, or walk in — booked patients are always seen first.
a.zh: 三种方式：点击立即预约、致电前台、或直接到店——预约患者优先接诊。

q.en: What happens at my first visit?

a.en: A 30-minute session: medical history, full oral examination, digital X-ray if needed, and a written treatment plan with transparent pricing. No treatment starts without your consent.
a.zh: 约 30 分钟：病史采集、全口检查、必要时数字化拍片，并给出带透明报价的书面治疗方案。未经您同意不会开始任何治疗。

q.en: How much does teeth cleaning cost?

a.en: Standard ultrasonic cleaning with polishing is a flat listed price — see the price board or ask the desk; members get 20% off twice a year.
a.zh: 标准超声洁牙含抛光为明码标价——见价目表或询问前台；会员每年两次享 8 折。

q.en: How much is a dental implant?

a.en: Implant cost depends on the system and bone condition; a written quote comes with your X-ray consult. Installment plans are available.
a.zh: 种植费用取决于植体系统与骨条件；拍片面诊后出具书面报价，支持分期。

q.en: Do you accept insurance?

a.en: We accept major private dental insurance and process claims at the desk; bring your card. Public insurance covers basic items per local policy.
a.zh: 支持主流商业齿科保险，前台可直接理赔，请携带保险卡。基础项目按当地政策使用医保。

q.en: Will the treatment hurt?

a.en: Modern anesthesia makes most procedures painless; we explain sensations beforehand and you can pause any time with a hand signal.
a.zh: 现代麻醉下绝大多数操作无痛；治疗前会说明体感，过程中举手即可随时暂停。

q.en: Do you treat children?

a.en: Yes — pediatric dentistry every day, with a kids corner and gentle-first visits designed to build trust before treatment.
a.zh: 看——儿童齿科每日开诊，设儿童角，首诊以建立信任为先。

q.en: What if I have a dental emergency?

a.en: Call the 24/7 emergency line immediately. Knocked-out tooth: keep it in milk and come within 30 minutes for the best chance of saving it.
a.zh: 立即拨打 24 小时急诊电话。牙齿脱落：泡在牛奶中，30 分钟内赶到，保牙成功率最高。

q.en: Do you offer teeth whitening?

a.en: In-clinic cold-light whitening (about 60 minutes) and take-home tray kits; a quick exam first confirms which suits your enamel.
a.zh: 有冷光美白（约 60 分钟）与家用牙托套装；先做快速检查确认适合的方案。

q.en: Do you do braces or aligners?

a.en: Both traditional braces and clear aligners. Free initial orthodontic consult each Saturday; scans and simulation before you decide.
a.zh: 传统托槽与隐形矫治都做。每周六正畸初诊免费；决定前先扫描并模拟效果。

q.en: Is a root canal really necessary?

a.en: Only when the pulp is infected — we show you the X-ray and explain alternatives; untreated infection risks losing the tooth.
a.zh: 仅在牙髓感染时需要——我们会展示片子并说明替代方案；拖延感染可能导致失牙。

q.en: Does tooth extraction take long?

a.en: Simple extractions take 10–20 minutes; impacted wisdom teeth 30–60 with a surgeon. Aftercare sheet and review call included.
a.zh: 简单拔牙 10–20 分钟；阻生智齿 30–60 分钟由外科医师处理。附术后护理单与随访电话。

q.en: Should wisdom teeth be removed?

a.en: Not always — we assess pain, position and cleaning access on X-ray. Symptom-free, well-positioned wisdom teeth can stay.
a.zh: 不一定——按疼痛、位置与清洁可达性评估拍片。无症状且位置好的智齿可以保留。

q.en: How do I know if I have a cavity?

a.en: Sensitivity to sweet or cold, dark pits, or food trapping are signs; a checkup with X-ray settles it in minutes.
a.zh: 对甜/冷敏感、黑点、塞牙是信号；门诊检查加拍片几分钟即可确认。

q.en: My gums bleed when brushing — serious?

a.en: Usually early gum inflammation, very treatable with a professional clean and technique fix; persistent bleeding deserves a periodontal check.
a.zh: 多为早期牙龈炎，洗牙加刷牙方法矫正即可改善；持续出血建议做牙周检查。

q.en: Why are my teeth sensitive?

a.en: Worn enamel, gum recession or grinding. Desensitizing treatment plus habit fixes usually calm it within weeks.
a.zh: 多因釉质磨损、牙龈退缩或磨牙。脱敏治疗加习惯调整通常数周见效。

q.en: How can I fix bad breath?

a.en: Most cases trace to tongue coating, gum disease, or dry mouth — a cleaning plus targeted routine solves the majority.
a.zh: 多与舌苔、牙周或口干有关——洁牙加针对性护理可解决大多数情况。

q.en: How often should I get a checkup?

a.en: Every 6 months for most adults; every 3–4 months if you have gum disease or braces. Kids: twice a year from the first tooth.
a.zh: 多数成人每 6 个月一次；牙周病或正畸期 3–4 个月。儿童自长第一颗牙起每年两次。

q.en: What payment methods do you take?

a.en: Cards, mobile pay, cash, and installments for treatments over the plan threshold. Invoices issued on request.
a.zh: 银行卡、移动支付、现金；大额治疗支持分期。可开具发票。

q.en: Is parking available?

a.en: Free patient parking behind the building (2 hours); street parking and a transit stop are one block away.
a.zh: 楼后有患者免费停车（2 小时）；街边车位与公交站一个路口即到。

q.en: What hygiene standards do you follow?

a.en: Instrument sterilization is autoclave-tracked per patient, surfaces disinfected between visits, and single-use items never reused.
a.zh: 器械按患者独立高温高压灭菌并留档，诊间逐客消毒，一次性用品绝不复用。

q.en: Can I get my dental records or X-rays?

a.en: Yes — your records belong to you. Ask the desk for digital copies; transfers to another clinic are free.
a.zh: 可以——病历属于您本人。前台可导出电子版；转诊至其他机构免费提供。

q.en: What is your cancellation policy?

a.en: Free cancellation up to 24 hours ahead; late cancellations may incur a small fee since the slot is reserved for you.
a.zh: 提前 24 小时取消免费；临时取消可能收取少量占位费。

q.en: I grind my teeth at night — what helps?

a.en: A custom night guard protects enamel immediately; we also screen for stress and bite alignment factors.
a.zh: 定制夜磨牙垫可立即保护牙齿；同时评估压力与咬合因素。

q.en: What are veneers and do I need them?

a.en: Thin porcelain shells for shape and color fixes on front teeth — great for chips and stains, decided after a smile assessment.
a.zh: 修复前牙形态与颜色的薄瓷片——适合缺角与染色，经微笑评估后决定。
